Risk stratification for neurosensory damage in orthognathic surgery
items.summary: Neurosensory disturbance (NSD) of the inferior alveolar nerve (IAN) is a frequent complication in bilateral sagittal split osteotomy (BSSO). This study aimed to clarify factors and stratify the risk of this complication. Consecutive patients who underwent BSSO between 2020-2023 in Santiago, Chile, were enrolled.

Efficacy of Oral Bromelain in Reducing Postoperative Facial Oedema Following Surgical Management of Midfacial Fractures: A Prospective Randomised Placebo-Controlled Trial
items.summary: Postoperative facial oedema following surgical management of midfacial fractures contributes to patient discomfort and delayed recovery. Although non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and corticosteroids are commonly used, their adverse effects limit prolonged use.

items.title: Efficacy And Safety Of Submental Intubation Versus Tracheostomy In The Airway Management of Panfacial Fractures: A Systematic Review and Meta Analysis
items.summary: Airway management in panfacial fractures is challenging, and tracheostomy has traditionally been used when oral or nasal intubation is unsuitable. This review aimed to compare the efficacy and safety of submental intubation versus tracheostomy.
